newsitem.title: UK: Olives Property up after director buying.
newsitem.headline: Olives Property up after director buying.

text.p: Shares in Olives Property Plc rose 12 percent on Monday after a weekend press report highlighted recent share purchases by directors of the real estate company.
The stock was up 3-1/4p at 30-1/4 by 1242 GMT in thin volume of 199,250 shares.
The Sunday Times said director Geoffrey Lawson had recently bought 100,000 shares at 29p and said other directors had bought at 24-1/2p late last year.
It said recent acquisition Wessex Trust was lifting profits and that the company had recently announced the first of three property disposals to reduce borrowings.
"Investors might think it timely to follow recent director buying," the paper said.
